_doc: Gold languages for the empirical trust/contest analysis (contest_rule / phase2 / trust_profile). Add a language by aligning it (eflomal + gloss) and adding one line here — no code edit. `clear` = positional Clear-Bible attestations (data/resources/strongs/attestations/<iso>.parquet); `lexicon` = karnbibeln Strong's→Swedish (stem-tolerant). Languages listed but not yet aligned are auto-skipped until their align_eflomal/align_gloss jsonl exist. We already HOLD Clear gold for asm/ben/hin/por/rus/spa — they just need ingest+align to join.
_edition_doc: Each entry may be a bare backend string (legacy) or {gold, edition, base_text}. `edition` is the ingest-cache tag (pipeline/work/ingest-cache/usj-<edition>) that IS the translation the gold was built against, and `base_text` is Clear's own name for it. THIS MATTERS: scoring requires the SAME translation the gold describes, and most of these languages have many ingested editions — picking by book-count or alphabetically silently scores one Bible against another Bible's gold. Live case (2026-08-31): spa was scored on spa_bes instead of spa_r09 and gap-fill precision read 10.9%; against the right edition it is 54.8%. Resolve with contest_rule.gold_edition(iso), never by globbing.
_gbt_doc:
`gold: gbt` = globalbibletools occurrence alignment (CC0), extracted by gbt_align.py to pipeline/work/occurrence_align/gbt_<iso>.jsonl. LOOSER than Clear: gbt's gold is a gloss PHRASE per source word and it glosses its OWN target text, not the edition we align — positional agreement with Clear where both exist is eng 83.9% / hin 63.4% / spa 61.7%. Use gbt for A/B-ing our own variants and for reach, NEVER to compare absolute scores against a Clear language.
CHECK COVERAGE BEFORE TRUSTING A LANGUAGE: `gbt_align --coverage` reports usable rows. The raw jsonl row count is SOURCE WORDS and is ~448k for every language regardless of whether the gloss project has any target text at all — measured 2026-09-01, only eng/spa/por/hin exceed 50k usable rows, while amh/kan/mal/tgl/tpi have under 2k and were removed from this file again after being added on the row count alone. `gbt_usable_rows` / `gbt_greek_rows` below are the measured numbers; Greek rows are what an NT-only test can use.
These four are listed because each has a Grambank feature no usable Clear gold language has (GB117=0 no copula / GB250=0 no transitive 'have'), which is what the docs/pipeline-overview.md #4 gate needs to validate. They are INERT until aligned — every consumer auto-skips a language with no align_* jsonl. tam is the only real GB117=0 candidate (4,854 Greek rows); tel/njm are OT-heavy and cannot test a Greek copula.
SEPARATELY VALUABLE: gbt_rus has 38,969 Greek rows and Clear's rus gold is QUARANTINED for being positionally scrambled — gbt is an independent reference that could rehabilitate rus as a gold language. Not wired up here; see the _quarantine note.
_quarantine:
rus WAS quarantined for BAD GOLD (not a fixable alignment issue): Clear's RUSSYN gold is itself positionally mis-aligned — ~57% of its per-verse strong->word pairings are wrong (EXO 1:1: H3478/Israel->'вошли'/came). Verse boundaries agree 100%, and our aggregate strong->surface is correct, so it is an intra-verse scramble no versification remap can reach.
REHABILITATED 2026-09-01 by switching rus to `gold: gbt`. The gold-health diagnostic (positional agreement vs lexical agreement; a large gap means the gold's per-verse word choice is wrong even though its overall vocabulary is right) run on the SAME rus alignment against both golds:
    vs CLEAR gold: positional 38.7%  lexical 66.4%  GAP 27.7pt  <- scrambled (reproduces the 2026-07 diagnosis)
    vs GBT   gold: positional 54.5%  lexical 56.0%  GAP  1.5pt  <- HEALTHY
So the defect is Clear's, exactly as diagnosed, and globalbibletools' independent CC0 occurrence alignment is a sound reference for the same language. rus rejoins the gold set for NT work only. Its absolute score is not comparable to a Clear language's (see _gbt_doc). Clear's rus parquet is kept on disk; re-check if Clear ever reships a corrected rus.
NOT the cause, checked and ruled out 2026-09-01: a spine mismatch. rus_syn is textual_basis verdict `tr` (carries all 15 diagnostic verses incl. all 4 TR-only), while Clear's rus gold is keyed to SBLGNT — but re-aligning rus against the TR spine moved the gap 27.7 -> 27.9pt, i.e. nothing. And 8 of the 10 Clear gold editions are `tr` (arb/asm/ben/fra/hin/por/rus/spa), several of which score fine, so the TR/critical mismatch is not what makes rus special.

rus.note: NT ONLY (gbt rus has zero Hebrew rows). Rehabilitated 2026-09-01 — see _quarantine.
